what makes us, us

the russian manicure

A Russian manicure is a dry, detailed manicure. Your tech uses an electric file with fine bits to work around the nail and cuticle in small, careful passes, with no soaking and no clipping.

You get clean edges, tidy cuticles and a smooth base for color. It takes a little longer than a quick polish change, and that care is what you are paying for.

everything about it
  1. 01

    Removal

    Any previous gel polish comes off first. This is included in every gel manicure.

  2. 02

    Cuticle work

    Dry, detailed cleanup around the nail with the e-file. No soaking.

  3. 03

    Shape

    Your nails are shaped to the length and form you want.

  4. 04

    Strengthening

    A layer of hard gel or builder gel goes on to give the natural nail extra support.

  5. 05

    Color

    Gel polish in the color you choose, finished and cured.

our staple

russian manicure

This style of manicure is done dry. Rather than soaking and clipping, your technician uses a small electric file to work around each nail and cuticle with slow, precise movements.

You end up with crisp edges, neat cuticles and an even base for color. It takes longer than a quick polish change, and the extra time is what makes it last.

questions

Does it hurt?

It should not. If anything feels uncomfortable, tell your tech right away and they will adjust.

Is there soaking?

No. A Russian manicure is done dry.

How long does it take?

A manicure with no polish is booked at 1 hour. Gel manicures are 1 hour 30 for short and medium nails and 2 hours for long nails.

Do you remove my old gel?

Yes. Removal of previous gel polish is included in every gel manicure. Acrylic or dip powder is a separate removal.

How long will it last?

It depends on your nails, your daily routine and how fast your nails grow. Ask your tech what to expect for your hands.

Can I add nail art?

Yes. Simple designs, French, chrome, cat eye and ombre are all add-ons. For very detailed hand-painted art, ask when you book.

questions

Is it really done without soaking?

Yes. Our smart pedicure is a dry pedicure.

How long does it take?

A pedicure with no polish is 1 hour. With regular polish or gel polish it is 1 hour 30. The men’s pedicure is 1 hour 45.

What is Advanced Foot Care?

It is an add-on for heavily callused, dry, cracked or very rough heels. It gives your tech extra time and detailed foot care beyond a regular smart pedicure.

Can I do a manicure and pedicure together?

Yes. The Mani Pedi Combo is a gel manicure plus a smart pedicure with gel polish, by one technician. Plan on about 3 hours.

Do you do men’s pedicures?

Yes. The men’s smart pedicure is on the menu, with no polish.

questions

How long does a full set take?

Plan on about 2 hours for a short or medium full set.

Which lengths do you offer?

Short and medium full sets are on the menu. Ask when you book if you want something different.

What if only one nail breaks?

A single nail extension rebuilds one nail to match the length and shape of the rest. It is priced per nail.

Can I get French or chrome on top?

Yes. French, chrome, cat eye, ombre and simple designs are add-ons.

What if I already wear acrylic or dip?

It needs to be removed first. That is a separate 30 minute removal service.
